info.title: SARB repo rate decision — November 2026
info.description: The South African Reserve Bank Monetary Policy Committee announces its repo rate decision on 19 November 2026. The repo rate is the rate at which the SARB lends to commercial banks and is the country’s headline policy rate. Exactly one of cut, hold or hike resolves YES.

markets.title: Hold
markets.description: The MPC leaves the repo rate unchanged.
markets.rules: Resolves YES if the repo rate announced by the SARB MPC on 19 November 2026 is exactly equal to the rate prevailing immediately before the announcement, as published in the SARB’s official MPC statement. If the outcome cannot be determined from the named source by the determination date, the market is voided and all collateral returned.

markets.title: Cut
markets.description: The MPC lowers the repo rate.
markets.rules: Resolves YES if the repo rate announced by the SARB MPC on 19 November 2026 is strictly below the rate prevailing immediately before the announcement, as published in the SARB’s official MPC statement. Any cut resolves YES regardless of size. If the outcome cannot be determined from the named source by the determination date, the market is voided and all collateral returned.

markets.title: Hike
markets.description: The MPC raises the repo rate.
markets.rules: Resolves YES if the repo rate announced by the SARB MPC on 19 November 2026 is strictly above the rate prevailing immediately before the announcement, as published in the SARB’s official MPC statement. Any increase resolves YES regardless of size. If the outcome cannot be determined from the named source by the determination date, the market is voided and all collateral returned.
